actual permitted trial methods, equipment and measurement requirements

inputs: exact checked cultivation trial design, plot assignments and current readiness
actual field conditions and measured crop/soil responses

actual trial/plot/treatment identifiers

actual research question, design and scientist-selected analysis

tasks.design: For the cultivation-method research route, configure fixed trial/plot context and native analysis setup profiles in {OPS_SYSTEM}, the field research data system. The scientist designs and checks the actual trial, conducts field work, captures real observations and checks the final analysis/findings in {DOCS} before saving the internal study revision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated trial identifiers and analysis setup add clerical work around field research.
tasks.enabler_now: Native field forms and reusable statistical setup can reduce repeated entry/setup.
tasks.still_hard: Trial validity, variable field conditions and uncertainty require research judgment.
tasks.human_edge: Choose a valid comparison and interpret what observed crop responses establish.

ambition.what: No invented yield benefit or autonomous field trial.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-2; research/site owners validate trial authority, field access and profiles

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native trial forms and statistical setup profiles can reduce repeated handling while horticultural study design, field work and inference remain scientific work.

assumptions: Unmeasured cultivation-method trial episode, one stated horticultural operation. Gross 19 x .10 + 20 x .10 = 3.9; upkeep 1; net 2.9 hours per 100.
Scientist produces trial/plot definitions in s1, actual observations in s2 and captures/reconciles them in s3. No free sensor feed or pre-structured observations; absent data stays missing.
Only fixed identity and repeated analysis setup change. Existing arithmetic/statistical runtime, field operations, biological waiting and final scientific checking earn no saving.

s1 checks exact trial assignments/procedure and current readiness before s2; changed design/conditions require renewed checking. Final completed actual study check s4 gates s5; edits invalidate that gate.
Same-system study save 1 is fully retained and earns no saving. No external publication, new field permission or automatic recommendation is promised.
unknowns: Actual current trial-entry and analysis setup burden
research_questions: Which fixed fields/setup recur after preserving all actual observations and uncertainty checks?

tasks.design: Configure current evidence/reference views in {OPS_SYSTEM}, the research reference/laboratory record system. tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated navigation to current efficacy and environmental evidence adds review effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source views can make relevant existing evidence easier to locate.
tasks.still_hard: Control efficacy and environmental safety cannot be inferred from a plausible method description.
tasks.human_edge: Design valid trials and state what actual evidence leaves unresolved.

ambition.what: No unmeasured environmental-safety claim or automatic field application.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native research views can reduce evidence navigation while crop-control development and environmental interpretation require actual specialist experiments.

assumptions: Unmeasured authorised controlled development-trial episode. Gross 15 x .10 = 1.5; upkeep .5; net 1 hour per 100.

Actual sources have their research producers; scientist retrieves/reads them in s1, produces candidate/procedure in s2-s3 and actual observations/record in s4-s5. No free structured trial results or missing environmental values.
Only navigation changes; all design, actual application/observation, analysis and writing stay. No novel treatment, dose or environmental baseline is invented here.

Final exact procedure/material/setup/current readiness s3 gates trial s4; changes require renewed check within existing authority. Final actual record authoring/check s5 gates s6; edits invalidate gate.

tasks.design: For a study of existing composting evidence/data, configure native source views and analysis setup profiles in {OPS_SYSTEM}, the research reference/data system. tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated source navigation and analysis setup add clerical study effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Native saved reference views and analysis profiles can reuse recurring setup.
tasks.still_hard: Study comparability and sustainability trade-offs require contextual scientific interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: Judge what real composting evidence supports across crop and soil conditions.

ambition.what: No invented sustainability baseline or unmeasured improvement.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-2; research-data owner validates actual dataset access and profiles

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native reference and analysis profiles can reduce repeated study setup while composting evidence comparability and sustainability interpretation remain scientific judgments.

assumptions: Unmeasured existing-data study episode. Gross 35 x .05 + 30 x .10 = 4.75; upkeep 1.5; net 3.25 hours per 100.

Only navigation/repeated setup changes; actual selection, unit/method harmonisation, uncertainty and findings remain counted. Existing arithmetic/solver runtime earns no saving.

Same-system save 1 is fully retained with no saving. Final complete-study check s3 gates exact internal version/destination; edits require recheck. No external publication or farm-practice change is promised.

tasks.short: Consult construction engineers on soil problems

steps.what: Read actual construction-project soil investigation records, site constraints and engineers' questions in soil/GIS project records (OPS_SYSTEM)
inputs: actual construction project and technical consultation question
actual soil investigation/laboratory/site records from their producers
outputs: scientist-reviewed project soil evidence and gaps

steps.what: Assess actual effects of soil problems and possible solutions in the construction context, making evidence limits clear
inputs: scientist-reviewed project soil evidence and gaps
actual construction interfaces and scientist's scope of competence
outputs: scientist's supported soil-problem assessment and possible solutions

steps.what: Consult with engineers or other technical personnel working on construction projects about soil-problem effects, possible solutions and actual project constraints
inputs: scientist's supported soil-problem assessment and possible solutions
actual engineers' constraints, questions and clarifications
outputs: actual clarified soil advice and agreed evidence limits

steps.what: Write and check the agreed actual soil consultation advice, source limitations, final attachment and intended external engineering recipient
inputs: actual clarified soil advice and agreed evidence limits
actual project/case identity and intended engineering recipient
outputs: exact final checked written soil advice, attachment and recipient

steps.what: Send the exact checked written soil advice and attachment to the intended external construction engineer
inputs: exact final checked written soil advice, attachment and recipient
outputs: sent actual soil consultation advice

tasks.design: For a technical consultation with an agreed written advice deliverable, configure current soil/site record links in {OPS_SYSTEM}, the soil/GIS project record system. The scientist assesses the actual issue, consults with engineers and writes/checks the final advice in {DOCS} before sending the exact checked version through {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Locating current soil/site evidence can add consultation preparation effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Native project-reference views can reduce navigation to existing evidence.
tasks.still_hard: Construction implications and possible solutions depend on actual soil evidence and project constraints.
tasks.human_edge: Explain uncertainty and coordinate advice within professional competence.

ambition.what: No automatic design approval or replacement of project engineering authority.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-2; project-data owner validates source access and external advice scope

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native project-reference views can reduce soil consultation preparation navigation, while interpretation and technical advice remain specialist work.

assumptions: Unmeasured documented technical consultation with an actually agreed written advice deliverable, not an assumed report after every conversation. Gross 20 x .10 = 2; upkeep .5; net 1.5 hours per 100.
Actual investigation/lab records already exist; scientist reviews/reconciles them in s1. Missing site or soil evidence requires actual investigation, never inferred values.
All assessment, live consultation and actual written advice remain fully retained. Only source navigation changes; no independent construction-design certification or project decision is promised.

Final written advice and attachment exist and are checked with exact recipient in s4 before distinct send s5; any edit or recipient change requires recheck. Send click 1 remains fully retained with no saving.
unknowns: Actual written-deliverable requirement and navigation time
research_questions: Does the actual consultation include written advice, and how much preparation is avoidable navigation?
